assumptions: ME6211C50M5G-N:dropout_voltage is stated for load_current in [0.1, 0.2] and is used at 0.5; this is an extrapolation the vendor does not support
the declared bound extrapolates the typical slope to the port budget and adds the pass device's rise with temperature

assumptions: bare board in still air, mounted horizontally, no enclosure and no forced convection
heat leaves only by natural convection and radiation from the two faces of the outline, with emissivity 0.90
the board is isothermal: no spreading gradient between the LED ring and the regulator is modelled
the regulator's thermal resistance is the one implied by its package dissipation rating and maximum junction temperature, for the smallest five-pin package its datasheet lists
